role: Lithiated carbon — baseline anode for comparison against nitrate-derived Li3N interphase. In anode-free SSB without AgNO3, carbon host gets lithiated, and Li adatom diffusion on graphene basal plane sets the lateral homogenization rate.

crystal_structure.li_position: hexagon center (hex hollow) of carbon layer

hex_hollow_to_hex_hollow.ts_site: bridge between two carbons (above C-C bond)
hex_hollow_to_hex_hollow.minima: two adjacent hex hollows (true minima, no further bridge correction)
